title: Integral compact-support character duality for two-term torus complexes on curves over finite fields, including primary characteristic torsion
author: Cyril Demarche; David Harari
work: Duality for complexes of tori over a global field of positive characteristic
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.129
difficulty_reason: Finite-flat Artin-Mazur-Milne duality controls derived torsion realizations even at the characteristic prime. Topological compact-support dévissage, divisible-kernel limit analysis, and finite-generation Tate-module vanishing produce integral perfect dualities rather than prime-to-characteristic approximations.
